L3-3.evidence: Probleme mit Nebenkosten, Kündigung oder Mieterhöhung? Unsere Juristen beraten Mitglieder persönlich und per Telefon.
L3-3.evidence_en: Problems with utility bills, notice or rent increases? Our lawyers advise members in person and by phone.
L3-3.question_en: Mr Yilmaz is in trouble with his landlord over the utility bill and needs advice.

L3-4.evidence: Erdgeschoss, 78 m², ruhige Lage am Stadtrand, 850 € warm. Haustiere ausdrücklich willkommen!
L3-4.evidence_en: Ground floor, 78 m², quiet location on the edge of town, €850 incl. heating. Pets explicitly welcome!
L3-4.trap: G hat einen Balkon, aber „leider keine Haustiere“. C ist nur eine Ferienwohnung.
L3-4.trap_en: G has a balcony but no pets. C is only a holiday flat.
L3-4.question_en: Sarah and Tom are looking for a flat with a garden where pets are allowed.

L3-5.evidence: Wir kaufen gebrauchte Sofas, Schränke, Tische und Betten und holen sie kostenlos bei Ihnen ab.
L3-5.evidence_en: We buy used sofas, wardrobes, tables and beds and collect them from you free of charge.
L3-5.trap: B transportiert Möbel, kauft sie aber nicht.
L3-5.trap_en: B moves furniture but doesn't buy it.
L3-5.question_en: Miriam is moving to Hamburg and wants to sell her old furniture, but she doesn't have a car.

L3-6.evidence: Öffnungszeiten Montag bis Freitag 9–18 Uhr, am Wochenende geschlossen.
L3-6.evidence_en: Opening hours Monday to Friday 9–6, closed at weekends.
L3-6.why: A verleiht Bohrmaschinen, hat aber am Wochenende zu. Er braucht sie am Sonntag – also keine Anzeige (0).
L3-6.why_en: A lends drills but is closed at weekends; he needs it on Sunday – so no ad fits (0).
L3-6.trap: A passt fast perfekt („Bohrmaschine“, „leihen“) – der Tag macht den Unterschied.
L3-6.trap_en: A almost fits perfectly – the day is what rules it out.
L3-6.question_en: Mr Berger wants to put up shelves on Sunday and needs a drill at short notice.

L3-7.evidence: Alle aus dem Viertel sind willkommen, besonders Menschen, die neu oder allein sind.
L3-7.evidence_en: Everyone from the neighbourhood is welcome, especially people who are new or on their own.
L3-7.why: Kontakt im eigenen Stadtteil, für Menschen, die allein sind (F).
L3-7.why_en: Contact in her own neighbourhood for people living alone (F).
L3-7.question_en: Mrs Petrova is 70, lives alone and would like more contact with people in her part of town.

L4-1.evidence: Ein Tier ist kein Grund, jemandem eine Wohnung zu verweigern.
L4-1.evidence_en: An animal is no reason to refuse someone a flat.
L4-1.why: Sie ist dafür, dass Tiere erlaubt sind (Ja).
L4-1.why_en: She's in favour of allowing pets (Ja).
L4-1.question_en: Nadine, Kiel: My dog is part of the family. Even so, for a whole year I didn't find a flat, just because almost every ad said "no pets". That isn't fair. An animal is no reason to refuse someone a flat.

L4-2.evidence: Genau deshalb muss ein Vermieter Tiere verbieten dürfen.
L4-2.evidence_en: That's exactly why a landlord must be allowed to ban animals.
L4-2.why_en: He wants bans to be possible (Nein).
L4-2.question_en: Holger, Bochum: I live above a family with three cats. The stairwell stinks, and in summer the flies come in through the window. The landlord told me he couldn't do anything. That's exactly why a landlord must be allowed to ban animals.

L4-3.evidence: Aber warum sollte ich entscheiden, was in der Wohnung nebenan passiert?
L4-3.evidence_en: But why should I decide what happens in the flat next door?
L4-3.why: Sie hat selbst keine Tiere, ist aber dafür, dass andere sie haben dürfen (Ja).
L4-3.why_en: She has no pets herself but thinks others should be allowed them (Ja).
L4-3.trap: „keine Haustiere und will auch keine“ klingt nach Nein – es ist nur ihre persönliche Situation.
L4-3.trap_en: "No pets and don't want any" sounds like Nein – it's only her personal situation.
L4-3.question_en: Aylin, Nürnberg: I don't have any pets myself and don't want any. But why should I decide what happens in the flat next door? As long as the dog doesn't bark all night, it's none of my business. And really none of the landlord's either.

L4-4.evidence: Deshalb muss er das letzte Wort haben.
L4-4.evidence_en: That's why he must have the final say.
L4-4.why: Der Vermieter soll entscheiden = nicht in jeder Wohnung erlaubt (Nein).
L4-4.why_en: The landlord should decide = not allowed in every flat (Nein).
L4-4.trap: Er beginnt mit Verständnis („Ich verstehe …“), dann „Trotzdem“ – das Signal für seine echte Meinung.
L4-4.trap_en: He opens sympathetically, then "Trotzdem" signals his real view.
L4-4.question_en: Rolf, Kassel: I understand that animals are important to many people, especially older people. Even so: whoever rents out a flat is responsible for the building. Damaged floors, smells, the neighbours' allergies – in the end the landlord pays. So he has to have the final say.

L4-5.evidence: Ein Verbot wäre grausam, vor allem für alte Menschen, die allein wohnen.
L4-5.evidence_en: A ban would be cruel, especially for older people who live alone.
L4-5.trap_en: Against a ban = for allowing pets.
L4-5.question_en: Sofia, Erfurt: Studies show that people with pets are healthier and less lonely. My grandma practically lives only for her cat. A ban would be cruel, especially for old people who live alone.

L4-6.evidence: In einem Mietshaus mit acht Parteien müssen alle Rücksicht nehmen.
L4-6.evidence_en: In a block of flats with eight households, everyone has to be considerate.
L4-6.why: Wer ein Tier will, soll ein Haus kaufen – in Mietwohnungen nein (Nein).
L4-6.why_en: Want a pet? Buy a house – not in rentals (Nein).
L4-6.trap: Die Geschichte mit dem Hund ist das Beispiel für seine Meinung.
L4-6.trap_en: The dog story is his example, not a separate point.
L4-6.question_en: Benjamin, Ulm: Anyone who absolutely wants an animal should buy a house with a garden. In a block of flats with eight households everyone has to be considerate. In our building the dog from the second floor bit the neighbour's cat – since then nobody talks to anyone.

L4-7.evidence: Ein generelles Verbot ist einfach Unsinn.
L4-7.evidence_en: A general ban is simply nonsense.
L4-7.why: Als Vermieterin ist sie trotzdem dafür (Ja).
L4-7.why_en: Even as a landlord she's in favour (Ja).
L4-7.trap: „Ich bin selbst Vermieterin“ lässt Nein erwarten – ihre Erfahrung ist aber positiv.
L4-7.trap_en: Being a landlord suggests Nein, but her experience is positive.
L4-7.question_en: Charlotte, Trier: I'm a landlord myself and have had tenants with dogs for ten years. Never a problem, not once. Anyone who handles their animal responsibly is usually a reliable tenant too. A general ban is simply nonsense.

L5-1.evidence: An Sonn- und Feiertagen gilt die Ruhezeit den ganzen Tag.
L5-1.evidence_en: On Sundays and public holidays the quiet period applies all day.
L5-1.trap: a) 13–15 Uhr gilt nur werktags. c) 22 Uhr ist eine Werktagsregel.
L5-1.trap_en: a) 1–3 pm is weekdays only. c) 10 pm is a weekday rule.
options_en: the quiet hours only apply at midday.
there has to be quiet all day.
you may play music until 10 pm.

L5-2.evidence: Fahrräder gehören ausschließlich in den Fahrradkeller.
L5-2.evidence_en: Bicycles belong exclusively in the bicycle cellar.
L5-2.trap: b) Im Eingangsbereich dürfen nur Kinderwagen stehen.
L5-2.trap_en: b) Only prams may stand in the entrance.
options_en: have to be taken to the bicycle cellar.
may stand in the entrance area.
may stand in the stairwell if they don't bother anyone.

L5-3.evidence: Sperrmüll (alte Möbel, Matratzen usw.) müssen die Mieter selbst bei der Stadt anmelden.
L5-3.evidence_en: Tenants must register bulky waste (old furniture, mattresses, etc.) with the city themselves.
L5-3.why: Selbst bei der Stadt anmelden = sich an die Stadt wenden (c).
L5-3.why_en: Register it with the city yourself (c).
L5-3.trap: a) Genau das ist verboten. b) Der Hausmeister kommt nur beim Garten vor.
L5-3.trap_en: a) That's exactly what's forbidden. b) The caretaker is only mentioned for garden parties.
L5-3.question_en: Anyone who wants to get rid of old furniture …
options_en: puts it next to the bins in the courtyard.
informs the caretaker.
has to contact the city themselves.

L5-4.evidence: Grillen mit Holzkohle ist auf den Balkonen nicht gestattet; ein Elektrogrill darf benutzt werden.
L5-4.evidence_en: Charcoal grilling is not allowed on balconies; an electric grill may be used.
L5-4.trap: c) 22 Uhr gilt für Feiern im Garten, und Holzkohle ist verboten.
L5-4.trap_en: c) 10 pm is for garden parties, and charcoal is banned.
options_en: you may only grill with an electric grill.
grilling is completely banned.
you may grill with charcoal until 10 pm.
